calls.statement: SELECT (SELECT max(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) maxdate, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) maxsale, (SELECT max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line) maxetl, (SELECT fiscal_period_label||' '||fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE DATE '2026-10-01' BETWEEN period_start_date AND period_end_date) per

SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-21' AND DATE '2026-10-04' ORDER BY f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.line_no

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, count(f.sales_line_id) lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dl, count(DISTINCT f.sale_ts_utc||f.receipt_id||f.line_no) dk, sum(f.quantity) q
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=131) f ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-21' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1
